player_prompt.intro:
Ị bụ onye egwuregwu {player_id} na **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Nyefee egwuregwu gị dị ka **[macro  micro]** (ọnụọgụ abụọ 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-bọọdụ gị na-egwu
• *micro* = square gị n'ime mini-bọọdụ ahụ
Ọmụmaatụ `[7 8]` ➜ tinye akara gị na mini-bọọdụ 7, square 8, na
manyere onye mmegide gị ịgba na mini-bọọdụ 8 ọzọ.

Ị bụ `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mgbagharị ga-adị n'ụdị [macro micro] na ọnụọgụ 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ihe ndekọ ọ bụla ga-adị n'etiti 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, ahịrị, ma ọ bụ kọlụm dị na mpụga.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Onye na-egwu egwu ga-egwu na bọọdụ micro ọzọ.

game_action.played: Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na-egwu na micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Onye ọkpụkpọ {opponent_id} ga-egwu ugbu a na {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Onye na-egwu {player_id} na-emeri Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
